Sebastian Vettel won the 2010 drivers' championship, and the season standings list him with 5 wins. The race reports I retrieved support this: he won the Malaysian and European Grands Prix, and the Brazilian report shows him first. I did not retrieve every race result, so the count rests on the standings figure.

ANSWER: 5
